services.title: AI Solutions & AI Agents
services.seoDesc: Enterprise AI and intelligent business agents for government and enterprises: smart assistants, document search, automation, and analytics.
services.short: AI solutions that help government and enterprises automate tasks, improve access to information, analyze data, and support employees and customers.
services.hero: We help government entities and enterprises put AI to practical use by building intelligent solutions and business agents that access authorized information, execute tasks, and support employees and customers. AI Agents are designed around each organization's needs and integrated with internal systems, databases, documents, service portals, ERP and CRM platforms.

faqs.q: How is an AI Agent different from a traditional chatbot?
faqs.a: An AI Agent understands context, connects to authorized systems and documents, and can execute actions — a traditional chatbot is usually limited to scripted replies.

faqs.q: Can the agent be integrated with our existing systems?
faqs.a: Yes — through APIs, respecting the organization's data controls and access policies.

about.text2: A technology partner with extensive experience in integrated enterprise solutions
about.text3: ARABTEC is a Saudi technology solutions company founded in 1996. We help organizations plan, design, implement, operate and support their technology environments through a single point of accountability. Our expertise evolved from networks and infrastructure to include software development, business applications, automation, cloud and AI.
about.text4: ARABTEC team designing enterprise technology solutions
about.text6: To be a trusted technology partner for organizations and government entities — building integrated, scalable technology environments that serve their future goals.
about.text8: Delivering practical, measurable technology solutions that connect systems, data and operations to create clear operational value.
about.text11: Let's build your technology project together
